name: effective_io_concurrency
description: Number of simultaneous I/O operations the disk subsystem can handle efficiently; influences parallelism in bitmap heap scans and asynchronous I/O behavior.
symptoms: Poor query performance on I/O-bound workloads
tuning_tips: Set based on storage type: 1–10 for HDDs, 100–200 for SSDs, and higher (up to 1000) for NVMe or high-end SAN with async I/O support; validate using I/O profiling tools and workload benchmarks.
